questions.question: Synthetic diagnostic: each public fixture periodically updates a harmless visible status label. Should this scratch example publish only changes to the status, while preserving a timestamp for a fixture that has stopped? This choice changes no real settings or user data.

options.label: Publish changes only (Recommended)
options.description: Keep a public synthetic status current when the fixture changes. Record its timestamp only for the stopped synthetic example.

options.label: Keep periodic updates
options.description: Retain the harmless periodic publication in this disposable example. This does not change any actual running process or setting.
